descriptions.en: Pixel whale dashboard and touch remote for the AM01S USB sub-screen, showing DSH moods, sessions, approvals, and questions.
descriptions.zh: AM01S USB 副屏上的像素鲸鱼看板与触控遥控器，显示 DSH 状态、会话、审批和问题。

notice.en: Excluded from the Alpha.4 campaign because the current release has not completed the Alpha.4 migration and interaction validation. Keep using it only with its Alpha.1-compatible runtime.
notice.zh: 因当前版本尚未完成 Alpha.4 迁移和交互验收，本次不发布 Buddy。仅应在其兼容 Alpha.1 的 Runtime 中继续使用。
